purpose: Validate the pure semantic-to-visual fallback eligibility classifier and the first structured semantic target-resolution failure codes after fixing the contract runner environment bootstrap. No physical UI behavior is claimed.
requiredClaims: unknown or unstructured semantic failures fail closed and are not visually eligible
free-form error text is not parsed for eligibility
successful semantic results are never visually eligible
resolveSemanticTarget emits structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET and INVALID_INTENT codes while preserving successful resolution behavior
P5B remains classification-only and does not invoke P5A, perception, provider selection or persistence
Computer Use and Computer Control product trees remain clean
nonClaims: This session is not a physical UI validation and must not be described as one.
P5B does not wire visual fallback into OPEN or any executor; that is P5C.
P5B does not select or package a concrete perception provider; that is P5D.
P5B does not validate an agent-loop visual fallback task; that is P5E.
SURFACE_NOT_OBSERVABLE is defined as an eligible structured code but this checkpoint does not claim that every current executor already emits it.
No arbitrary action failure, delivery failure, verification failure, readiness failure, permission/backend failure or exception becomes visual-fallback eligible.
No free-form error-string compatibility shim is introduced.
